title: Recipe 14: Surface conformance vectors
titleZh: 方案14：Surface 一致性请求向量
summary: A fresh fixture runs nine protocol vectors covering version, method, record identity, schema, exposure, and replay. It is a repository check, not a certification.
summaryZh: 全新夹具运行九组协议向量，覆盖版本、方法、记录身份、schema、暴露范围与重放。这是仓库检查，不是认证。

files.label: README.md
files.role: Run and scope of the evidence

guide.title: Test the rejection boundary, not the screenshot
guide.titleZh: 测试拒绝边界，而不是截图
intro: Each vector compares an expected code with the protocol response and assumes a fresh fixture.
Run the suite, then read the result list from top to bottom. A pass says this fixture satisfied these repository vectors, nothing broader.
introZh: 每组向量都在全新夹具上比较预期错误码与协议响应。
运行向量后从上到下阅读结果。通过只表示当前夹具满足这些仓库向量，不表示更广泛的认证。

steps.title: Build a deterministic fixture
steps.body: The fixture declares read, write, folded-record, unavailable, and replay-sensitive capabilities.
steps.bodyZh: 夹具声明读取、写入、折叠记录、不可用与防重放能力。

steps.title: Keep expected codes explicit
steps.body: Every vector names its expected response code; success is compared the same way as failure.
steps.bodyZh: 每组向量都写明预期响应码；成功与失败使用同一套比较方式。

steps.title: State the boundary of the claim
steps.body: The panel does not certify transport, SSO, multi-tenant identity, browser support, or another implementation.
steps.bodyZh: 面板不认证传输、SSO、多租户身份、浏览器支持或另一套独立实现。
steps.match: This panel does not certify transport

guide.note: Run pnpm --filter @plingjs/surface test for the package suite. Report the result with fixture, protocol version, environment, and uncommitted state.
guide.noteZh: 包级测试用 pnpm --filter @plingjs/surface test。记录结果时同时写明夹具、协议版本、环境与工作区是否有未提交改动。
